description: This file is a shell script for handling platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures in the build or upgrade process of a device. It defines functions for checking the image and performing the upgrade, applying default behaviors unless specific conditions are met.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image; always returns success in its current implementation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, selecting the default upgrade method for the device's board if no specific case matches.
